# Preserved running audio before the bridge ascent

`preserved_prefix.json` records the actual float32 stereo mix for reel seconds
39–47 and all twelve original alert/Foley WAV hashes at merge `75023497`.
It was captured before changing the sequence end or adding crane acoustics.

The test uses the existing 800 ms three-actor timing fixture, 48 kHz samples and
the original production WAVs. Extending the film must preserve this exact PCM
prefix while continuing its current contact tails and loop phases after 47.
This is a retained before-change signal, not an invented envelope or a claim
that audio was recorded from mixer hardware.
